record.question: As provided u/s 43 of MLP Act 2019, who has the power to compound offences?
options: The Commissioner or any Excise and Narcotics Officer not below the rank of Assistant Commissioner.
The Assistant Commissioner of Excise and Narcotics.
The Commissioner, or any Excise and Narcotics Officer not below the rank of Inspector authorised by the Commissioner.
The Assistant Commissioner and Officer-in-Charge of Excise and Narcotics station.
